text:
Type: faux leather storage bench
Use: seating and storage at the foot of a bed or in a living room; bedroom, living room
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: faux leather upholstery, button-tufted lift-up lid, black block feet
Colors: dark brown, black
Shape: rectangular box with raised padded ends like low arms, tufted inset lid, short square feet, low and bulky
Feel: solid, cozy, practical
Goes with: dark wood, cream or grey walls, leather sofas; modern or classic living rooms

product.name: Amazon Basics Rectangular Faux Leather Storage Ottoman Bench, Large - Russet Brown
product.description: This product was previously sold as First Hill and now as Amazon Basics Rectangular ottoman bench with lift-open lid and roomy interior storage Durable wood construction with rubberwood feet for strength and stability Faux leather upholstery with a dramatic tufted finish for timeless, sophisticated style Child-safety hinge prevents lid from slamming shut; ideal for an entryway, living room, family room, or bedroom Measures 20 x 51 x 17.5 inches (LxWxH)
